notes: Pi header pins are read from the images. Odd pins are the top row and pin 1 is at the right end. The red wire goes to pin 1 (3V3), green to pin 7 (GPIO4) and black to pin 6 (GND). In the buzzer image the buzzer's green wire goes to pin 11 (GPIO17) and its black wire to pin 9 (GND).

Breadboard positions follow the buzzer image, which shows the whole build. Columns 1, 3 and 5 hold the LDR and capacitor, with wires in row f of each column. The LDR legs are at 1b.j and 3b.j. The capacitor POS is at 3b.i and NEG at 5b.i. The buzzer sits at columns 28 (black, negative, pin 1) and 30 (red, positive, pin 2). The wires for these are at 28b.f and 30b.f.
Circuit: 3V3 -> LDR -> capacitor positive and GPIO4 node, capacitor negative -> GND. This is the RC timing circuit the text describes.
The first image (RC circuit only) shows the same circuit on columns 1, 3 and 5 of the upper half. I used the second image's layout so the buzzer and RC circuit share one board.
The 1µF capacitor uses catalogue type capacitor-10uf, the only polarised capacitor entry, with value=1uF.
The laser pointer, straw and the socket-pin test leads are not circuit parts and are left out.
